title: The Son of Adam — the seed's own name: the ladder at Bethel, the judgment given to him, the ransom, and the going up (Genesis 28; Daniel 7; Psalm 8; Mark 10; John 1)
summary:
It ain't new. The name Yahusha (Jesus) uses for himself more than any other, the Son of Adam, has a lineage in it. Adam's book of generations runs straight down to Luke's:

*This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that Elohim (God) created man, in the likeness of Elohim (God) made he him;* (Genesis 5:1)

*Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of Elohim (God).* (Luke 3:38)

John opens the name with Jacob's ladder:

*And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of Elohim (God) ascending and descending upon the Son of Adam.* (John 1:51)

*And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of Elohim (God) ascending and descending on it.* (Genesis 28:12)

*And, behold, Yahuah (LORD) stood above it, and said, I am Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Abraham thy father, and the Elohim (God) of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;* (Genesis 28:13)

What Jacob saw set up on the earth with its top in heaven, the angels going up and down on it, Yahusha (Jesus) says they will see upon himself. He is the ladder. The one who stood above it and spoke the promise to Jacob's seed is the one now standing in front of Nathanael in flesh, and the flesh he stands in is that seed. The name carries the judgment too, and the reason given is the name itself:

*And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of Adam.* (John 5:27)

Daniel had seen one like him brought before the Ancient of days and given the kingdom. Daniel says *like*, and it stays *like* on his page; what is given there is the kingdom that does not pass:

*I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.* (Daniel 7:13)

*And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.* (Daniel 7:14)

The psalm asks what the son of Adam is that he should be visited at all, and answers with dominion:

*What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of Adam, that thou visitest him?* (Psalm 8:4)

*Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:* (Psalm 8:6)

Mark has the name at the forgiving of sins, at the sabbath, at the suffering, and at the ransom:

*But that ye may know that the Son of Adam hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)* (Mark 2:10)

*Therefore the Son of Adam is Adonai (Lord) also of the sabbath.* (Mark 2:28)

*And he began to teach them, that the Son of Adam must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.* (Mark 8:31)

*For even the Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.* (Mark 10:45)

Being master of the sabbath is not the sabbath put away; it is the one who made the day saying whose it is. And the ransom is the servant Isaiah saw bearing the iniquities of the many:

*He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.* (Isaiah 53:11)

Hebrews says why the name is a seed-name and not a title any man could wear:

*For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.* (Hebrews 2:16)

Ezekiel saw a man's likeness on the throne above the firmament long before the Son of Adam said where he had been before:

*And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.* (Ezekiel 1:26)

*And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of Adam which is in heaven.* (John 3:13)

*What and if ye shall see the Son of Adam ascend up where he was before?* (John 6:62)

*Therefore, when he was gone out, Yahusha (Jesus) said, Now is the Son of Adam glorified, and Elohim (God) is glorified in him.* (John 13:31)

The one who came down took Adam's line in the flesh, and the one who goes up is the same, and the name goes with him both ways. The ladder, the judgment, the ransom and the glory all hang on one word the translators flattened to *man*: Adam.

5007.prose: Yahusha (Jesus) says *Son, thy sins be forgiven thee* to a man on a bed, and the room hears it as too much. Daniel saw *one like the Son of Adam* brought near before the Ancient of days, and on Daniel's page it stays *like*. The one forgiving on earth is the one Daniel saw given the kingdom above.
5007.phrase: behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven
5007.sentence: Daniel sees one like the Son of Adam brought near the Ancient of days, and the same name stands in the room forgiving the man on the bed.

5009.prose: Here Yahusha (Jesus) says the name outright: *the Son of Adam hath power on earth*. Daniel saw *one like the Son of Adam* come to the Ancient of days, and Daniel keeps the *like*. What Daniel sees given from the throne is what is being used on earth, in front of a man who could not walk.
5009.phrase: and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him
5009.sentence: The one brought near the Ancient of days in Daniel is the Son of Adam who here forgives sins on earth.

5021.prose: Daniel saw *one like the Son of Adam* come to the Ancient of days, and Daniel keeps his *like*. Yahusha (Jesus) says the Son of Adam is master *also of the sabbath*. That is the one who made the day saying whose it is. The sabbath is not put away. It stands, with its owner standing in front of it.
5021.phrase: one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days
5021.sentence: The one Daniel saw come before the Ancient of days is the one who says the sabbath is his, and he says it to keep the day.

5139.prose: The woman's seed is the one who bruises the serpent's head, and the heel is where he is bruised. Yahusha (Jesus) says the Son of Adam *must suffer many things* and be killed, and then rise. The heel comes first, and the head after.
5139.phrase: it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel
5139.sentence: The seed of the woman crushes the serpent's head and is bruised in the heel, which is the suffering the Son of Adam says he must go through.

5141.prose: The psalm asks what a son of Adam is that he should be visited at all. Yahusha (Jesus) answers with a hard word: the Son of Adam *must suffer many things*, and be rejected by the elders and priests. The psalm that asks it goes on to give him dominion, so the road runs through rejection to that.
5141.phrase: and the son of Adam, that thou visitest him
5141.sentence: The psalm's son of Adam, visited from above, is the one who is rejected and killed and then rises after three days.

5140.prose: Yahusha (Jesus) says the Son of Adam will be rejected, killed, and rise after three days. Daniel saw *one like the Son of Adam* brought near before the Ancient of days. Suffering and coming near belong to one person. Daniel keeps his *like*, and Yahusha (Jesus) speaks the name straight.
5140.phrase: and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him
5140.sentence: The one who is brought near the Ancient of days in Daniel is the one who must first suffer and be killed.

5154.prose: Whoever denies Yahusha (Jesus) before men is denied before the Father in heaven. Mark says the Son of Adam will be ashamed of that person *in the glory of his Father*. The judgment is given to the Son of Adam, and it is given before the Father, who is not set aside.
5154.phrase: him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven
5154.sentence: Denying him before men is answered by his denying that person before his Father, which is the Son of Adam acting as judge in the Father's presence.

5155.prose: Luke has the same saying with the angels in view. The one who denies Yahusha (Jesus) before men *shall be denied*, and Mark's Son of Adam comes *with the holy angels*. Both verses stand at one judgment, and the name Son of Adam is the one who confesses or denies there.
5155.phrase: he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels
5155.sentence: The denial before men is answered before the angels of Elohim (God), the same company that comes with the Son of Adam in his Father's glory.

5156.prose: Paul writes the same saying down for those who suffer. They will reign with him, and whoever denies him will be denied by him. It is the weight Yahusha (Jesus) puts on the Son of Adam being ashamed. Judgment follows what a person did with him and his words.
5156.phrase: if we deny him, he also will deny us
5156.sentence: Denying him is met with his denying, which is the same judgment given to the Son of Adam in Mark.

5180.prose: Daniel sees the Ancient of days seated, with a throne *like the fiery flame*. The one brought near him receives; he does not seize. Yahusha (Jesus) sends his men to prayer and fasting, the posture of one who has a Father and asks. The power in the room comes from the one on that throne.
5180.phrase: the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow
5180.sentence: The Ancient of days sits on the throne the Son of Adam is brought before, and the power he uses comes from there through prayer.

5184.prose: The Son of Adam is given into men's hands and killed, and Isaiah had already said why. The servant was *wounded for our transgressions*, bruised for iniquities, and the stripes heal. The one who rises the third day is the one who carried that.
5184.phrase: he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities
5184.sentence: Isaiah's wounded and bruised servant is the Son of Adam delivered to men and killed.

5183.prose: In Daniel the one brought near before the Ancient of days, *like the Son of Adam*, is given an everlasting kingdom. Yahusha (Jesus) says the Son of Adam is delivered up, killed, and rises the third day. The throne and the death sit in one name, and Daniel's word stays *like*.
5183.phrase: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven
5183.sentence: The Son of Adam who is given the everlasting dominion in Daniel is the same who lays down his life.

5212.prose: The ransom for many is Isaiah's servant, who justifies *many* and *shall bear their iniquities*. Yahusha (Jesus) says the Son of Adam came to serve and give his life as a ransom for many. It is the same many and the same bearing, and the serving is done before the being served.
5212.phrase: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many
5212.sentence: Isaiah's righteous servant who justifies many by bearing their iniquities is the Son of Adam giving his life as a ransom.

5213.prose: The one Daniel saw *like the Son of Adam* come to the Ancient of days is the one who says he came *not to be ministered unto, but to minister*. The dominion Daniel saw given comes by way of a life laid down as a ransom. Daniel keeps his *like*, and Yahusha (Jesus) speaks the name.
5213.phrase: behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven
5213.sentence: The one Daniel saw coming with the clouds of heaven is the Son of Adam who gives his life as a ransom for many.

6972.prose: At twelve, Yahusha (Jesus) says he must be *about my Father’s business*. Years later he calls the temple *my Father’s house*. It is the same Father, the same house, and the same one speaking. He is Elohim (God) and he has a Father, and both times he says so plainly.
6972.phrase: make not my Father’s house an house of merchandise
6972.sentence: The house he guards in the temple is his Father's, the same Father whose business he said as a boy he must be about.

6981.prose: Luke's line of fathers ends at Adam, and Genesis opens that line. *This is the book of the generations of Adam.* Adam was made in the likeness of Elohim (God), and Luke carries the line down through Seth and Enos. The Son of Adam is a name with a family behind it.
6981.phrase: In the day that Elohim (God) created man, in the likeness of Elohim (God) made he him
6981.sentence: Adam's book of generations begins with Adam made in the likeness of Elohim (God), and Luke's line runs down to the one called the Son of Adam.

8205.prose: Jacob saw a ladder with its top in heaven and *the angels of Elohim (God) ascending and descending* on it. Yahusha (Jesus) tells Nathanael they will see the same upon himself. He is the ladder, set on the earth with its top in heaven, and the flesh he stands in is Adam's line.
8205.phrase: a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven
8205.sentence: The ladder at Bethel is what Yahusha (Jesus) says is now seen upon the Son of Adam.

8204.prose: Above the ladder stood Yahuah (LORD), and he gave Jacob the land and *to thy seed*. Yahusha (Jesus) says the angels go up and down upon the Son of Adam, so the one standing before Nathanael stands in that seed's flesh. The promise and the ladder meet in him.
8204.phrase: I am Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Abraham thy father
8204.sentence: The one who stood above the ladder and spoke the promise to Jacob's seed is the one now standing in flesh before Nathanael.

8196.prose: The psalm asks what a son of Adam is that he should be visited, and goes on to dominion over the works of the hands of Elohim (God). John gives the answer a face. The authority to judge is given to Yahusha (Jesus) *because he is the Son of Adam*.
8196.phrase: and the son of Adam, that thou visitest him
8196.sentence: The psalm's son of Adam, visited and given dominion, is the Son of Adam to whom judgment is given in John.

8203.prose: Daniel's page says *like*, and it stays *like* there. John's page says plainly that the authority to judge is given *because he is the Son of Adam*. Each speaks in its own words. Both have a giving, and both have the name.
8203.phrase: one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days
8203.sentence: Daniel sees one like the Son of Adam brought before the Ancient of days, and John says the judgment was given to the Son of Adam.

8202.prose: Both verses turn on a giving. John says the Father *hath given him authority*, and Daniel says dominion and a kingdom were given that all should serve him. Daniel's kingdom does not pass away. The judgment is part of what is handed to the Son of Adam, and the name is why.
8202.phrase: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away
8202.sentence: The dominion that never passes away is what stands behind the judgment given to the Son of Adam.

8195.prose: Ezekiel sees *the likeness as the appearance of a man* upon the throne. Yahusha (Jesus) asks what they will do when they see the Son of Adam ascend *where he was before*. Ezekiel says likeness and appearance, and Yahusha (Jesus) says where he was. The one who goes up goes back to a place he had.
8195.phrase: upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it
8195.sentence: The prophet saw the likeness of a man above the throne, and the Son of Adam says he goes up to where he was before.

8199.prose: Isaiah's servant *shall be exalted and extolled*. Yahusha (Jesus) says the hour has come for the Son of Adam to be glorified, and the glory is that lifting. The same chapter goes on to the marring of his face, so the height comes by the road of the cross.
8199.phrase: he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high
8199.sentence: The servant who is exalted and made very high is the Son of Adam glorified when his hour comes.

8198.prose: The crowd asks *who is this Son of Adam?* They heard from the law that Messiah (Christ) abides for ever, yet the Son of Adam must be lifted up. The psalm has Yahuah (LORD) tell the one at his right hand to sit until his enemies are a footstool. The lifting is the road to that sitting.
8198.phrase: Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool
8198.sentence: The one lifted up is the one set at the right hand until his enemies are made his footstool, so the lifting leads to reigning.

8197.prose: Judas has gone out, and Yahusha (Jesus) says the Son of Adam is glorified and Elohim (God) is glorified in him. Daniel saw one like the Son of Adam given *dominion, and glory, and a kingdom*. The glory said at that table is the glory given there, and the Father is honoured in the Son, not set aside.
8197.phrase: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away
8197.sentence: The glory named at the hour is the glory given with the everlasting dominion in Daniel.

fable_read: Claude Fable 5.1 read every card (25): Daniel's like kept on every Daniel 7 card, Revelation not read through Daniel; 6981/8196 'Elohim (God)'s' recast; no theological corrections. Checker: 5184 a 9-word run of Mark 9:31 reworded.
